mapper.select:
select FINPROD_ID as hidCode, FINPROD_MARKET_ID as code , FINPROD_NAME as shortName from FIN_PRODUCT where 1=1 and FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F06,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and (FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{finProdMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) OR FINPROD_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{finProdMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')))
select CUSTOMER_ID as id, CUSTOMER_NAME as text from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO where 1=1 and IS_ASSTE_MANAGER = #{YES_OR_NO_Y,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select a.FINPROD_ID finprodId, a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, a.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, a.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, a.MANAGER manager, a.CCY ccy, a.VDATE vdate, a.MDATE mdate, a.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, b.TYPE_6 fundType, b.TYPE_7 secondType, c.IS_COMPOUND_INT isCompoundInt, d.CUSTOMER_ID manager, f.PAY_TYPE divideMethod, f.PAY_CYCLE carryoverFreq, case when c.PUR_SPEED = 0 then '01' when c.PUR_SPEED = 1 then '02' else '03' end purSpeed from FIN_PRODUCT a left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO d on d.CUSTOMER_ID = a.ISSUER left join FIN_CASH_INFO e on a.FINPROD_ID = e.FINPROD_ID and e.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and e.FINPROD_TYPE = #{FIN_CASH_BUSINESS_TYPE,jdbcType=VARCHAR} left join FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE f on e.CASH_ID = f.CASH_ID and a.VDATE = f.EFF_DATE , FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE b , FIN_PRODUCT_ADD c where 1=1 and a.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID and a.FINPROD_ID = c.FINPROD_ID and a.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F06,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select a.FINPROD_ID finprodId, a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, a.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, a.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, a.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, a.IDATE idate, a.CCY ccy, a.VDATE vdate, a.MDATE mdate, a.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, a.MANAGER manager, c.PUR_SPEED, c.RED_SPEED, c.INVEST_NATURE investNature, c.TOFF_STRDATE, c.TOFF_ENDDATE, c.TRM_FUND_TYPE, c.ETF_TYPE etfType, c.BONUS_TYPE bonusType, c.TDY_REV_TRANS tdyRevTrans, c.LISTING_DATE listingDate, a.CALENDAR_ID calendarId from FIN_PRODUCT a left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO b on b.CUSTOMER_ID = a.ISSUER left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD c on c.FINPROD_ID = a.FINPROD_ID where a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select CUSTOMER_NAME from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO where CUSTOMER_ID = #{manager,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select c.PAY_TYPE payType, c.PAY_CYCLE payCycle, c.DAY_VALUE dayValue, c.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, c.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule from FIN_PRODUCT b, FIN_CASH_INFO a left join FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE c on a.CASH_ID = c.CASH_ID left join FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE d on a.CASH_ID = d.CASH_ID left join FIN_RATE_INFO e on e.CASH_ID = a.CASH_ID left join FIN_CASH_PLAN f on a.CASH_ID = f.CASH_ID where b.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.FINPROD_TYPE = #{FIN_CASH_BUSINESS_TYPE_01,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{CASH_TYPE_1_02,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_2_C02,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and c.EFF_DATE = b.VDATE

SELECT PARTY_TYPE3 repPartyType3, PARTY_TYPE2 repPartyType2, PARTY_TYPE1 repPartyType1, INDUSTRY repIndustry, INDUSTRY2 repIndustryLevel2 FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD
CUSTOMER_ID = #{issuer,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
